subject: liston
note: Three jazz musicians born in 1926. All joins; nothing judged here except the she_said blocks, which come from her_words.json.

she_said.summary: Bryant said John Coltrane was in Dizzy Gillespie's band when Liston first joined it, and Liston agreed.
she_said.one_liner: was in dizzy's band with him
she_said.bryant_quote: Is that the band with John Coltrane in it?
she_said.notes: Liston's only response is 'Um-hmm.' (295649). 'Dizzy found a spot for him to go' in 295643 has an unclear 'him' - probably not Coltrane.
